newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan expected to award Mar gas oil around $25.60.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan expected to award Mar gas oil around $25.60.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) is expected to award its gas oil sale tender at around $25.60 per barrel for March 1-12 lifting, free-on-board (fob) Kaohsiung, a CPC source said on Thursday.
CPC might award one or two cargoes later on Thursday, the source said.
Traders said the price was consistent with current spot market level.
The tender, which offered 225,000-to-250,000-barrel cargoes of 0.3 percent sulphur gas oil, closed on February 18 and was valid for two days.
The CPC source said the tender attracted about five bids.
In its last tender, CPC sold two 225,000-250,000-barrel cargoes of gas oil at around $29.50 per barrel for January 26-February 15 lifting, fob Kaohsiung.
